evidence: Official overview4.2 Agriv used Qwen3-8B and this exact checkpoint together for patient-phenotype features, with contextual/positional features and OOF LightGBM. This is motivation, not proof of marginal benefit in our pipeline.
existing_search_scope: Local saved experiment records only; no new remote disk survey at feasibility stage.

proposed_minimal_protocol.task: Task2 same frozen CID/PID candidate pool; no new entities or alternative label support.
proposed_minimal_protocol.baseline: Frozen strict32-adapted Qwen3.5-9B F1 .660942003, not identical model to official Qwen3-8B; isolates marginal diverse evidence over current pipeline rather than reproducing champion.
proposed_minimal_protocol.native_CPU_first: If assets available, exact repository tokenizer/template/config, no ordinaryQwen template or enable_thinking. Hash all inputs; real prompt lengths determine eligible resource and budgets before any NN.
proposed_minimal_protocol.format_cost_probe: Only if later authorized: first, median and longest prompts by exact native token length, deterministic tie by existing row order, no gold, one sampled response each seed20261024/temperature.6/top_p.95, hard max_new_tokens1024 and single180s+TERM30 wrapper including load. Native natural final only; no forced closing/retry/output scan. Preserve truncation/invalid as missing evidence; if no usable finals or cost fails stop without automatic larger thought budget.
proposed_minimal_protocol.full_same_pool: Only after actual probe and explicit scope: one80-response frozen run with same fixed cap/seed policy, all output SHA frozen before unique evaluation. Compare DeepSeek alone and predeclared old-union-new, no learned F1 threshold. Invalid/missing is abstention with separate feature, never negative or gold repaired. Keep old entity support and primary baseline unchanged.
proposed_minimal_protocol.future_learned_fusion: Only if complementary evidence warrants: add presence/validity/agreement signals to existing relation classifier using new strict document-OOF DeepSeek features on the training side. Never train fusion using F1 evaluation labels or old newly-held-exposed models. All trained components keep actual source manifests.
